balls.text: he's holed out to long-on!  Won't get the orange cap  but what a knock he's played. Absolutely incredible. Faf went after this full ball, looked to swing this over long-on, but just didn't get enough on it.
off the toe end as he went for a pull, Morgan with a fumble running back from mid-off to concede a second run
clears his front leg and hammers this down to long-off
slower bouncer, Faf was through with the pull even before the ball arrived, somehow managed to get some bat on this, trickles to deep square
another full toss, this one's swung away towards cow corner for two more
full toss on leg, swung away towards deep midwicket
drilled to long-off
he goes straight and clears the ropes! Varun went length and this just sat up nicely for him to swing freely. Too much width as well. This is poor bowling
off a thick inside edge as this rolls to short third man. Faf was looking to hoick this into the leg side over deep midwicket
steps out, Varun drops short but Moeen swings wildly to get a thick edge on the bounce to short third
bisects wide long-on and deep midwicket with precision! Length on middle and leg, right in Moeen's swinging arc. Went flat-batted
swing and a miss! Moeen backed away to swing this over long on but missed this length ball

ah! What wrists, what bottomhand! Lockie goes length outside off and Faf whips this over midwicket. My word, he nearly cleared the boundary. 19 off the over, ends what has been a nightmarish outing for Lockie. That's sport. Cruel. Spare a thought for Lockie, he's been excellent all season.
goes over cover and clears the ropes! Lockie went slow and full but wide outside off, Faf used the room to swing that freely. That was right in the slot to be picked off.
slower length ball but slips it down leg, on the bounce to the keeper. Faf was looking to nudge it fine
swung away into the leg side, not quite off the middle, down to Gill at long-on
right into his swinging arc and Moeen clears his front leg and lofts him over extra cover. Poor bowling, Moeen was absolutely ready as it arrived.
terrific from Nagarkoti, saved two runs by throwing himself full-stretch at fine leg. Full and angling in from around the stumps, this flew off Moeen's pads as he attempted to tickle it fine
toe-ends this length ball to Morgan at the edge of the ring at cover, he didn't grab that cleanly on the bounce though.

clears his front leg and goes straight, clears the ropes! Mavi went for another yorker but just missed his length, Moeen had already made room, so it turned out to be a half-volley that helped him tee off.
right into the blockhole again outside leg-stump, Faf squeezes this to long-on
another excellent yorker, Faf can only hit it as far back as the bowler
full outside off, drilled to long-off
good comeback! Right into the blockhole, dug out
he's swung this cleanly, way over deep midwicket! Slower length ball angling across, Moeen held his shape and then brought out that freeflowing swing to get maximum power.
swung across the line to deep midwicket, couple of bounces to the fielder
slower and fuller outside off, drilled straight to mid-off
arches back to steer this short ball outside off to deep point
slower yorker outside off, Faf is beaten as he tries to back away to carve it through the off side

right into the blockhole, Faf squeezes this into the midwicket region and scampers back for a second even with Mavi not having to move left or right. Just the speed at which he was off the blocks meant Mavi was under pressure immediately
off the edge and four! Slower length ball into the pitch, Faf makes room to cut and gets a thick edge that races between point and short third.
right into the blockhole, squeezed to deep point
flayed into the gap at deep point, excellent work by Mavi, needed Faf to put in a full-length dive to make it back. A better throw closer to the stumps on the bounce may have had Faf
full and angling into the pads, Moeen is struck on the pad as he looks to flick behind square, they'll scamper a leg bye
slips this into the pads, tucked to deep backward square leg
slower delivery into the pitch on middle, turned into the leg side for a single
beats him first ball with a skiddy length delivery outside off, Moeen was looking to hit on the up
this one turns in, Faf is well forward as he defends. Narine's done with the ball, 2-26 off his four overs.
breaks away from a length outside off, steered to point
sliced over point, down to Mavi in the deep

big appeal for lbw and given by umpire Nitin Menon! Uthappa was looking to play a reverse sweep. He reviews. I think it'll come back as umpire's call. There's absolutely no bat involved, so all we need to see if where the impact was. And ball tracking confirms this was marginally within the stumps. And so Uthappa will have to go. What a knock he's played though.
picks this up on a length and swings this over deep midwicket! That's a solid hit again
fires this on a length but way outside off, wide called
sharp turn from outside off, he tucks this into the leg side for a quick single
just wide of cover! Huge chase for Iyer but he does well, 12 off the over. Uthappa walked across, took this on the full as he tried to go over the infield
whips this to deep midwicket
skiddy leg-break on off, defended gently
saved by an inside edge! Uthappa played outside the line as the ball cut back in sharply

he's muscled this over deep midwicket! For a moment, I thought he got more elevation than distance but then you just need to clear the ropes, no extra runs for bigger hits anyway. Uthappa has a point to prove against KKR, his former team, and he's looking in sparkling form!

fired full outside off and Uthappa manages to manufacture a neat-little stroke as he opens the bat face to squeeze this towards deep point, superb work from Venky Iyer to run around the ropes and pick up the ball one-handed to fire a rocket throw
squirts that off a thick inside edge towards midwicket, Nagarkoti the boundary rider had a lot of work to do
dropped!  But that was absolutely smashed back as Uthappa stepped out to go up and over. Catchable but not easy. Ouchhhhhh
backs away and lofts it through the line to long-off
swept hard from outside off but straight to Mavi at deep square
steered straight to short third this time.
width on offer, cut away into the gap at deep point for two
can you believe it? Faf's bat face turned as he made contact  but still managed to just clear long-off. Brings up a terrific 35-ball half-century. Cometh the hour, cometh the man
dugs this short but sprays it too far wide outside off, left alone
wristy from Uthappa as he whips this length ball from outside off to deep midwicket
slower and fuller on the stumps, squeezes this to Morgan at the edge of the ring at cover
absolutely slapped! Short of length outside off, around the fifth stump, that's giving Faf too much width. At 147kph, all he needed was to use the room to muscle it up and over.
clears his front leg and wallops this pull into the midwicket boundary! Lockie tried to get it up to his ribcage from wide of the crease, but didn't get it to bounce as much as he would've liked.
starts off with a leg-cutter outside off, touch short, cuts it straight to point. Had zero pace to work with.
clubbed over deep midwicket! Hammers that across the line, as Shakib goes on a good length and wide of off. Uthappa hangs back in his crease, and clobbers another six in the over
short and just outside off again. Cut away to deep point
fired over long-off! A very confident stroke, as he times that wonderfully. The ball is full and wide of off, and he lofts that effortlessly for the maximum
goes for the slash to this short and wide ball outside off, and is beaten
goes heaving at this full ball outside off, which is tossed up. Gets that off the inside half of the bat toward midwicket, as Shakib gives the chase
shortish and wide of off. The ball doesn't take off from the surface, and du Plessis pulls to deep midwicket away from his body
leading edge, as he clips this full ball on middle. A single down to deep point eventually
this one turns into him. Good length ball on off, and he pushes to cover. Sent back by his partner
fullish on middle an off, with good bounce. Pushed to long-on
driven down to long-on as he plays this full ball on off with the full face of the bat
goes for the reverse-sweep first ball! He plays at this full ball outside off. The ball takes his glove and tickles Karthik's right pad, before rolling over to the off side

dances down, and slices to long-off! Narine strikes immediately after the break. Gaikwad came down the pitch early, and looked to loft that full delivery outside off. But the bat face seemed to have opened last moment as Narine seemed to have bowled the knuckle ball, and the ball landed right where the man was placed
full ball on middle, and turned away toward square leg. Karthik scampers to his left to cut that off
another back of a length ball on middle and leg, and clipped to deep midwicket yet again
short delivery again on off, and pulled to long-on
stays deep in his crease, as he pulls that shoritsh ball on middle and leg to deep midwicket
another pretty full ball on middle and leg, and clipped to fine leg with the closed face of the bat
full ball on middle, and pushed back to the right of the bowler, who has a little colisson with the batter
pretty full on off, and again flicked to deep midwicket, where Nagarkoti remains busy
gets a leading edge to cover off his clip, as the ball is on a  good length on middle and off
goes deep in his crease to pull this short ball on middle, but plays that to the left of deep midwicket. The man there doesn't collect cleanly, but no extra run given
another back of a length ball on off, and clipped to deep midwicket again
flicks this good length ball on off to deep midwicket with the closed face of the bat
good length ball on middle, and pushed between long-on and deep midwicket. The latter runs to his left to stop that
very full on middle and leg, and driven to mid-on to round off the powerplay. Super Kings raise their fifty too
crashed over the bowler's head! This is short of a length and wide of off, and du Pleesis hoicks at that with a flat bat
this is again shortish in length and outside off. Finds cover with his flash. And it is a no-ball
pretty full on off, and driven to midwicket again. Mavi dives to his left to stop that
short of a length and outside off, pushed to the man at midwicket
another shortish ball on middle, as it is clipped to the left of the man at short fine leg
good length ball on middle, and a hint of turn into him. Tapped back
again stands by making room, as he pushes at this back of a length ball on middle to mid-off and takes for a quick single

mid-on thinks about a leap, but there was no chance there! du Plessis heaves at that across the line, as the ball is slightly on a good length outside off. The bat face closes as he attacks that, and beats the fielder by quite a mile
gets this tickle off the outside edge, as he opens the bat face late to this good length ball outside off
stays deep in his crease, as he taps at that good length ball on middle and off toward cover. The bowler gives the chase to his left
dabs late at this good length just outside off, and plays to short third man
pulls this back of a length ball outside off from deep in his crease, but finds the man at midwicket
and beaten now! Short delivery and a touch wide of off, as du Plessis tries to slash but misses

mid-off dives to his left, but can't get a hand! That is right in the driving length and in the slot just outside off, as du Plessis drives playing from middle and leg. Beautiful presentation of the bat
pulls his length back to go on a good length on off, which is clipped to deep square leg with the closed face of the bat
gorgeously sliced! Backs away outside leg early, as Ferguson bowls a yorker length on middle. He dabs at that really late with the open face of the bat, and places that to deep point
Gaikwad dives to the keeper's end, and is safe in the end! Hard length ball outside off, and du Plessis leans into it toward cover. Morgan runs to his left and throws, but misses
full ball on middle, and angling in. Turned away to deep square leg from deep in his crease. Nice, quick pick up and throw by the man there
stands by making room outside leg, as he bunts that good length ball outside off to mid-off. Rapid run gobbled
hoicked across the line to long-on, after he stepped down to that full ball slightly wide of off. The ball off the inside half of the bat
goes slightly short on middle and off, as Gaikwad pushes that late to point
to deep midwicket now! Short of a length ball on middle and leg, and he rocks back in his crease to pull that powerfully with his front leg out of the way
swept hard to deep backward square leg! Goes down on his back knee to this full ball outside off, and swings that away for another four

dropped by Karthik? Or has he missed a stumping? It is the latter. Shakib tosses it up fullish outside leg, with du Plessis driving on the up after making room and missing. But Karthik misses, and the ball trickles for a bye
goes fishing at that, but doesn't get bat on ball. It is on a good length and outside off, as he plays without foot movement and while opening the bat face
full ball on off, and in the driving length. He presents the full face of the bat to play that to mid-off off the front foot
squares him up! Gaikwad goes driving at this back of a length ball just outside off, as the ball just straightens after landing to beat the full face of his bat, as he plays from middle and leg
misfield at short third man by Varun, and that allows to. Gaikwad opens the bat face to this good length ball outside off, and simply tickles that behind
goes fullish on off, and du Plessis clips that to deep square leg with the ball angling into him
lands this full and straight on off. du Plessis defends back off the front foot with his head right down
cuts this short ball just outside off, but the fielder at short third man dives to his right to prevent a run. Varun the fielder there
this skids on off a good legthh on middle, and comes into him. Punched to the man at cover
swept to deep square leg for the first four of the day! Short of a length on middle and leg, and he goes down on his back knee to send that packing
clips this good length ball on middle, which is angling in, toward midwicket for a single
pretty full and a touch wide of off. Bunted back to the bowler
goes pretty full on middle, as Gaikwad pushes at it to mid-off to take for a quick run to get off the mark
right into the blockhole, turned to the leg side.  Chennai Super Kings are champions of IPL 2021 - their fourth IPL crown

has he cleared the ropes? Nope, just turns out to be catching practice for Deepak Chahar at the deep midwicket boundary. Bravo with a slow offcutter into the stumps, Mavi had to manufacture too much power to clear the long boundary there.
looks to reverse ramp that slower delivery, beaten.
slower and fuller outside off, hoicked into the leg side for a single
squeezes this yorker-length delivery to deep point
between his legs! Rightly goes yorker length from wide of the crease, Mavi was looking to whip this over square leg
swing and a miss! Lucky to get away with this length ball. Dhoni's asking Shardul 'what is going on'. Has a grimace on his face as he goes to the other end.
digs this into the pitch but it sits up superbly for Lockie as he muscles this over deep midwicket. Super hit that

Ruturaj with an outstanding stop running around from wide long-off! Shardul bowls a full toss, Lockie gets it up and over, wondering if he's got enough bat on it to find the boundary. And then from nowhere, Ruturaj comes sprinting around and then throws himself at the ball to cut off two
another wide as he attempts another slower one. Lockie was looking to swing this across the line
dug into the pitch but bowls it way outside off, wide called, Dhoni isn't happy with that
no-ball as this is well over the waist, Lockie somehow manages to get some bat on it, into the fine leg boundary.
full toss outside off, he steps out to swing this over long-on but misses
cutter on a length outside off, bunted wide of cover
sees the batter trying to scoop and bowls this full and way outside off, given wide
bottom-edges this cut to Dhoni who stops it on the bounce
steers this slower one down to third man
full toss outside leg and Mavi has whipped this over fine leg for six! He's having some fun
he's sliced this for six! Bravo goes full and wide, Mavi backs away, opens the bat face and reaches out to carve this over square third man
off a thick edge, beats short third to the boundary.
beaten as he backs away to carve this behind point
swung away down to long-on, flat hit
can't pierce the off-side ring, backs away and squeezes his straight to cover
high full toss, swung down to fine leg
right into the blockhole as this tails in late, squeezed past cover

such is Morgan's luck that  even his best-timed shot finds the fielder. Chahar has done outstandingly well at fine leg to leap high, get his hands on the ball. He then lets go of the ball as he goes over the ropes, comes back in and calmly grabs the ball back. Morgan sees that on the big screen and walks back disappointed.
off the thigh pad as he tries to swing this into the leg side, Bravo hares across to stop that
slower length ball angling away, Morgan misses the pull
slapped up and over the infield, just clears Gowtham at cover
nearly deceived by the slower bouncer, just rolls wide of the stumps as he tried to get some bat on it. Got into an awkward position because he was trying to swat it to the leg side

he's not timed that and Moeen takes a simple catch moving to his right at long-on! Thakur dug this into the pitch, got a bit of bounce and Tripathi got it off the top part of the bat as he looked to swing that over the ropes. It's all falling apart for KKR. Lord Shardul, as they call him, continues to have a dream run in the UAE
up and over cover, Jadeja comes around to cut that off in the deep but Tripathi hobbles back
plays the delicate dab to short third, takes off for a run instinctively, only for his hamstring to yell at him saying 'noooooooo'
slapped away to deep point

struck on the pad and gone! Shakib plays all around this sharp-spinning delivery, misses it and that would've crashed into the stumps. Jadeja was so confident that he was running in celebration even before the umpire raised his finger.
fired on middle, spins past Shakib's nudge, wide called. Sharp glove work down leg as Dhoni whips the bails off.

Rayudu didn't have to move an inch! Karthik's eyes may have lit up as he saw this short and angling in, he rocked back and thought he'd helped it along well, but found deep backward square leg. Is that the beginning of the end for KKR this season?
hit hard, down to Gowtham at long-off. Flat hit as Morgan reached out to whack this tossed up delivery
has he found the gap? No, there's Rutu at deep midwicket as DK pulls this short ball
beaten as he tries to fetch a sweep from way outside off. Jadeja held his length back and slowed it down nicely
off the pad and rolls into the leg side as Jadeja fires one in. Karthik was looking to nudge that into the leg side
slower and fuller outside off, DK reaches out to drive this wide of cover for a single.
early into the pull, off the glove into the off side as they scamper a single
steps out and punches this to sweeper cover
he's pulled his first ball for six! Chahar went short outside off, but this just sat up. DK picked the length early, swivelled back and hammered the pull over deep backward square leg.

brain fade or what? Gill is struck flush on the pad by this full toss as he walks across to scoop it over. It was so dead in front that  Chahar didn't even bother looking back  at the umpire and  Gill didn't even think of reviewing that.
beaten as he looks to pull this slower length ball outside off
fires this length ball wide outside off, Gill reaches out to toe end it into the off side as they scamper a single
Dhoni lets out a cry of anguish as Jadeja bowls a full toss and Gill pumps it over the infield to find the cover boundary, brings up his half-century off 40 balls
Dhoni appeals big as Gill sweeps and misses, surely that was to prevent the umpire from calling it a wide.
through Dhoni's gloves and legs as Gill gets a thick under-edge as he shapes to cut
fires one in on a length, Gill skips down and works it to long-on
drifts in a length ball from around the wicket, Gill plays all around it as he is struck on the pad.
full on the stumps, this one tails away a touch, Morgan squeezes this to cover
pulled all along the ground to deep midwicket, not timed as well as he would've liked
turns this to long-on to get off the mark

what a catch and it's Jadeja again at deep midwicket! Narine picked the bones out of this short ball and it looked set to sail over the ropes even as Jadeja ran back to catch. He also had to be mindful of the ropes behind him but he ended up taking it well in front by timing his jump to perfection. He kept his balance and didn't allow the momentum to take him over. CSK can sniff victory or what? This would've been a six in Sharjah
attempts a leg-stump yorker anticipating Narine to back away again, but he doesn't. Just shaves past leg-stump. Wide called, a tad harsh me thinks
clears his front leg and swings this into the leg side towards deep midwicket, off the mark immediately
skiddy length ball on middle, punched to mid-on
did that stick into the pitch? Looks like it did. Thakur bowls cross-seam length ball, Rana goes with hard hands but checked his shot and ended up chipping it to mid-off.  Double-strike for CSK
length outside off, hit hard but can't pierce mid-off, just one more
slips this full delivery down leg, Gill misses the flick, through to Dhoni

sliced high in the air, so high that the spidey was in danger of tipping this again, but it doesn't and Jadeja takes an excellent catch coming in from sweeper cover. The ball swerved a bit, Jadeja nearly misjudged it but managed to hang on. Iyer was looking to hit over mid-off.
whips this full delivery from outside off to deep midwicket
length outside off, slaps this straight to Moeen at extra cover
tucks him up by angling it in full as Gill tries to make room, worked towards deep midwicket
short and wide of off, and cut away to deep point
finds the gap between long-on and deep midwicket! The ball was short of a length and wide of off, and he swats that off the front foot to slam that for another four
reverse-sweeps this full ball on middle over short third man. Gets into position early, and bams that away for four
full ball outside off, and driven to short third man off the outside edge
looks to cut this good length ball wide of off but gets a top edge toward short third man. That's his fifty too, and off 31 balls
cracks that over deep square leg! Sweeps this full ball on his pads, with the ball turning into him a touch. Goes down on his back knee, and whacks that away
change of pace, and full and outside off. Pushed to long-off, with only four runs off the over
runs this very full ball outside off to point
charges down the track, and gets a full-toss outside off. But driven straight to extra cover
slower ball, and very full outside off. Pushed to extra cover, as Moeen runs to his right to stop that
low full-toss on middle, and swung away to long-on
full delivery outside off, and driven to long-off with the full face of the bat
rammed away over long-on! That is deposited milesss into the stands. Goes down on his back knee early to absolutely smoke that full ball on middle and off with a free swing of the arms
very full on middle, and opens the bat face to drive that to deep extra cover. That was bowled at 100.5 kph
skips down to this fuller ball outside off, and clips to long-on
back of a length and outside off. Swung away to the bowler's left
pushes this full ball on off to long-off
Gill dances down first ball, as Jadeja lands this short on middle, with the ball turning away. Good diving stop to his left by the bowler
and a slower ball again. Pushes this good length ball on off to extra cover
yorker on off, and another slower ball. Jammed back to the bowler, after Iyer initially tried to distract him by moving around his back leg
takes a step or two the wicket, and clips this full ball on his pads to fine leg. Thakur runs to his left to cut that off
a low, dipping full-toss wide of off. Dragged to long-on away from his body
Bravo dives to his left, and stops that. Again a change of pace ball, and pretty full on off. Pushed back to the bowler with an angled bat
slower ball on a fullish length on middle, and angling away. Clipped to deep midwicket

excellent fielding, but an overthrow and eventually a single. Gaikwad at cover dives to his right to stop that drive from Iyer, which came off a full-toss outside off. He threw at the bowler's end when he saw Gill was off early for a single, but missed. Gill dived back for life, as the ball raced away to allow a run
punches this back of a length ball wide of off to long-on
slices between mid-off and cover! Makes room, comes down the pitch and opens the bat face to loft that full ball on middle to raise the team's fifty
change of pace, and a full-toss outside off. Pushed to mid-off's right for a single
leading edge, and Chahar uses his left boot to stop that. Iyer goes for the flick to this full ball on middle, but plays a bit too early
slower ball on a good length outside off. Clipped to midwicket, with the man right on the edge of the circle
flicked away between Dhoni and short fine leg. The ball was fullish on his pads, and angling in. Just helped on its way by Iyer

just over Dhoni, and four! Can't really call that a catch, let alone a drop. He leaps with his right glove up atop, and the ball just flicks that. Iyer pulls this slower ball on middle and leg, which is short of a length. The ball takes his glove, and is skied
pretty full on off, and clipped to mid-on. Chahar there slides to his right to stop that
goes slashing at that shortish ball wide of off, but loses his bottom hand and misses the ball while playing away from his body
pulled away to deep midwicket. Deep square leg gives the chase to his left, as Gill hammers that short ball on middle and off
yorker first ball. Lands that right in the slot on middle, as Gill jabs that back with a flat bat
skips down to this back of a length ball on middle, and turns that away to deep square leg. Thakur at square leg gives the chase to his left
cuts this good length ball on middle and off to point, while playing from close to his body
goes way outside leg to create room and Hazlewood follows him. Bowls this full outside leg, as Iyer misses his slog for the ball to go between him and the stumps
sliced just to the left of the man at point! Opens the bat face to this full ball outside off, and again finds the gap between point and cover-point for four
pushes this full delivery on off to mid-on, and grabs a quick single

the ball slides below mid-off, who tries to dive forward while attempting to grab at that! Tough catch dropped by Thakur. He there ran forward a few steps before going low to grab at that, but ball slipped beneath his fingers after Gill slapped at that short of a length ball on middle and off
wide ball. Pitches on a good length on middle, and angles down leg further. Gill swings his bat, but doesn't connect
slower ball, and on a good length on middle. Keeps angling down, and clips his pad on the way to Dhoni on the bounce
now bisects mid-off and extra cover! Slightly opens the bat face to this full ball on off, and drives from the crease without much foot movement. Bang!
beaten now! Bowls a yorker just outside off, and with a change of pace. Tries to dab at that, but misses
good, crushing drive between point and cover-point! Drives at this good length ball just outside off with the full face of the bat, and finds the gap for four
clips this full delivery on middle to midwicket, with the ball angling in
bowls a slower ball on a good length on off, and from wide of the crease. Clipped to deep square leg
looks to flick, but the ball takes an inside edge on to his pad and then to third man, as Hazlewood continues with the good length ball on middle, which Gill plays after making room
pushes this length ball on off to mid-off
pulled over fine leg! Oh, he rubs salts in Super Kings' wounds. Short delivery on middle, and he swivelled while pulling that all the way to just beat Bravo

dropped by Dhoni! Oh, my! Dhoni goes collecting reverse-cup, but the ball clips his right glove and drops down. It was pitched back of a length on middle, and Iyer made room to try and ramp but edged right to the keeper, who fumbled
punches back this hard length ball just outside off
charges down first ball, as Hazlewood short of a length on middle, and gets that to angle in. Pulled to mid-on for a hurried single
goes driving at this length ball outside off, and plays with the closed face of the bat to mid-off
punches at that good length ball outside off to the man at extra cover. Four dots in a row after that boundary
again on a good length on off, and dabbed behind toward Dhoni, who takes his right glove off to collect that
taps this back of a length ball just outside off to point, with the ball angling away
and again backs away and takes a step down, but this time misses his clip to this good length ball on middle
makes room, and slaps that over midwicket! Takes a slight step down the wicket, and pulls that short ball on middle and leg, which moves away from him
bowls a wide first ball. This pitches on a fullish length outside leg, and keeps angling down the leg side
